nodes.label: Prompt injection via email — any AI reading your…
nodes.detail: 2026-08-06 · teaching (taught) · Prompt injection via email — any AI reading your inbox can be steered by text inside an email crafted to look like instructions. Why now: Aria reads your inbox daily; this is why she's read-only and treats email as data, never commands. Knowing the failure mode helps you spot it anywhere you wire AI to external input.

Why now: it's the mechanism keeping every employee's knowledge current without context bloat; the same pattern works for personal knowledge management.
